verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an authenticator app that stores account and credential data, so the axis applies. The pack only documents adjacent controls: an opt-in Usage Data sharing toggle, diagnostic logs that stay local until the user sends feedback, a Cloud Backup on/off toggle, and password export. Nothing shows users setting retention periods or deleting stored, backed-up, or Microsoft-held data, so these sharing, backup, and portability features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
